boundary.zh: Sendbird Chat 服务端 Platform API v3；不包含客户端实时协议、Chat SDK 或 Explinks 连接器抽象。
boundary.en: Sendbird Chat server-side Platform API v3 only; it excludes client realtime protocols, Chat SDKs, and the Explinks connector abstraction.

blockers.zh: 官方生成 SDK（固定 revision）已作为契约源完成 83 Endpoint / 172 Schema 的重建并补齐许可/再分发与传输审计；尚待独立 SDK/CLI 的生成、测试、npm 发布与 registry 干净安装复验。
blockers.en: The official generated SDK (pinned revision) served as the contract source for the reconstructed 83-Endpoint / 172-Schema contract, with license/redistribution and transport audits complete; the independent SDK/CLI still needs generation, testing, npm publication, and a clean registry install verification.

nextAction.zh: 生成并发布 @pontx/sendbird-chat-platform 与 pontx-sendbird-chat-platform（Node 18/20/22 CI、contract verify、生成漂移、typecheck、单测、E2E、tarball fresh-install），随后 metadata 准入、Preview/Production 与生产验收。
nextAction.en: Generate and publish @pontx/sendbird-chat-platform and pontx-sendbird-chat-platform (Node 18/20/22 CI, contract verify, generation drift, typecheck, unit tests, E2E, tarball fresh-install), then metadata admission, Preview/Production, and production acceptance.
